oneLine: UBS converts warrants into equity in 360 One for Rs 2,112 crore.

sources.title: UBS converts 360 One warrants into 4.8% equity stake after 2025 deal

synopsis: Swiss investment bank UBS AG acquired a 4.8% equity stake in Karan Bhagat's wealth manager 360 One Wam Ltd by converting 20.5 million warrants into equity shares. UBS paid the remaining 75% of the exercise price amounting to ₹1,584 crore ($190 million) on Thursday, having previously paid 25% when the warrants were allotted in July 2025. The total consideration for the warrant transaction reached ₹2,112 crore, with the latest tranche issued at ₹1,030 per share. This transaction follows a strategic alliance established in April 2025, under which UBS agreed to transfer its onshore wealth management business in India to 360 One for ₹307 crore and acquire warrants representing close to a 5% stake in the firm.
